svg.title: AI Command Gateway: Private Azure pilot - ARCH-004 v0.3
svg.desc: The private foundation, exact published OCI image, five verified input objects and dataset-analysis job form the retained pilot. Four bounded pilot modes were verified against execution records, artifacts or private diagnostics, including the expected safe configuration failure. Cleanup confirmed removal of the temporary operator VM, Bastion, both peerings, six extra DNS links and four scoped operator roles. Dashed paths show the completed, retired temporary access path. The foundation, job, image, five inputs and results are retained. Production gates remain open.

g.text: Bounded pilot verified - temporary access retired - production gates open
